coordinates.atom_order_convention: Source panel order. Atom id a<NNN> binds (index, species) and is stable across every frame of the reaction-path sequence.

migrating_atom_ids.note: no migrating-atom annotation exists in the bound sources

reaction_coordinate.definition: Zero-based NEB image index over the reaction-path sequence. Images are climbing-image NEB structures along a reaction coordinate; the index is NOT time, NOT dynamics, and implies no equal elapsed time.

unwrapped.note: unwrapped display coordinates are a presentation-layer derivative and are not part of this bundle

coordinates.wrapped_convention: Positions are the as-published wrapped source coordinates; no unwrapping or minimum-image transform has been applied.

diagnostics.note: no separately bound diagnostic receipts for this path; electronic diagnostics must not be inferred from the campaign record

charge.note: total charge is not in the campaign record

code_version.note: the campaign record does not carry the GPAW build; path-0 diagnostic logs report their own version inside diagnostics

convergence.note: SCF convergence criteria are not in the campaign record; anchor receipts carry per-evaluation status only

neb.scope: Protocol that generated the reference reaction-path sequence (locked nebDFT2k panel, DFT(PBE) climbing-image NEB). The GPAW anchors in this bundle are single-point evaluations on these images; images are a reaction-path sequence, not time.

occupations_smearing.note: occupation/smearing policy is not in the campaign record

paw_setups.note: PAW setup identities are not in the campaign record

spin.note: spin policy is not in the campaign record

container_digest.note: Phase 0 runs the converter directly, not in a pinned container

normalized_parameters.canonicalization: json sorted keys, 2-space indent, trailing newline

claim_evidence_ids.note: no claim/evidence IDs are bound at Phase 0

creators.note: the bound sources do not name individual creators

provenance.license: MIT; source Materials Project structures CC BY 4.0

organization.note: the bound sources do not name an organization

checks.detail: campaign + panel bytes match their .sha256 sidecars
checks.name: source_sidecar_hash

checks.detail: every frame has a 3x3 finite cell, PBC, angstrom units
checks.name: cell_and_units_declared

checks.detail: reference/model profiles match the frame count; GPAW per-value status
checks.name: profile_cardinality

checks.detail: every evaluated anchor lies inside the declared anchor universe
checks.name: evaluated_anchors_within_universe

checks.detail: all derived scalars recompute exactly to the campaign record
checks.name: campaign_record_crosscheck

checks.detail: every displayed value carries a frozen-asset JSON pointer
checks.name: source_pointers_resolve

warnings: Dense extension active on a <= 7-image path: sparse ≡ nearly dense by construction; same-engine verdicts are partly structural (gate-power caveat).
Images are a reaction-path sequence (NEB image index); never display the index as time, dynamics, or temperature.

cross_engine.contamination_note: Cross-engine evidence is secondary and contaminated whenever the T1 wander gate fails; the same-engine basis is primary.

quality_gates.denominator_policy: Errors are computed only over evaluated values; missing values are never imputed and never counted as observations.

same_engine.basis: same-engine (sparse GPAW vs dense same-engine GPAW profile)

t1.offset_definition: E_GPAW(i) - E_VASP(i) per evaluated image of the reaction-path sequence, in meV.

verdict.interpretation: The label combines the primary same-engine basis with the T1 convention-wander gate. A contaminated T1 verdict means the cross-engine numbers measure engine-convention luck; e.g. 'strong_win_t1_contaminated' is NOT a plain cross-engine win.
verdict.label: strong_win_t1_clean

dense_extension.note: Dense extension evaluates every image on short paths; supplied indices are evaluated images no guiding model nominated.

selection.extrema_tie_policy: First occurrence (lowest image index) for both argmin and argmax.
selection.subset_theorem: Exact barrier recovery follows when the evaluated set contains both dense-profile extrema (barrier_eq_barrier_of_extrema_mem).
selection.window_rule: anchors = {0, n-1, model-min} ∪ {model-max-window .. model-max+window}, clamped to [0, n) and de-duplicated; window = 2 when image_count <= 6 else 1

series.note: GPAW single-point evaluations on the reaction-path sequence.
series.zero_convention: Absolute GPAW total energy as recorded in the anchor receipts; no re-zeroing applied. Display layers may re-zero per engine path minimum but must retain these absolute values.

series.note: Reference energies for the same reaction-path sequence.
series.zero_convention: Absolute VASP reference total energy from the locked nebDFT2k panel; no re-zeroing applied.

series.note: uMLIP CI-NEB image energies guiding anchor nomination.
series.zero_convention: Absolute model-predicted image energies as recorded in the model cell artifact; no re-zeroing applied.
